AgorapulseAPIKeyCredential.title: Agorapulse API Key
AgorapulseAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: Paste your Agorapulse API key. NoClick sends it in X-API-KEY to api.agorapulse.com. Your organizations provide connection evidence.

profileUids.description: List of profile UIDs associated with the note. Optional on create, where omitting it attaches the note to no profile. Required on update, where [] detaches the note from every profile

profileUid.title: Profile Uid

itemId.description: Item id, as returned by the items endpoint. It also resolves the parentId and postId of an item, and the id an history event carries.
itemId.title: Item Id

searchId.title: Search Id

since.description: Take into account the items published after this date (inclusive), ISO 8601. Defaults to the start of the day six days ago, so an unbounded request covers the last seven days.
since.title: Since

until.description: Take into account the items published before this date (inclusive), ISO 8601. Defaults to the end of the current day.
until.title: Until

networks.description: Take into account the items from these social networks only
networks.title: Networks

sentiments.description: Take into account the items with these sentiments only
sentiments.title: Sentiments

keyword.description: Take into account the items whose extracted keywords include this one only, matched exactly and case-insensitively against the values the keywords endpoint returns. An unknown keyword returns an empty result. Items whose keyword extraction found no text or failed carry no keyword and are never counted.
keyword.title: Keyword

competitors.description: Take into account the items that matched these competitors of a competitive search only. The names are the ones the searches endpoint returns; an unknown name, or a search that is not competitive, is rejected. An item matching two competitors is counted for both.
competitors.title: Competitors

groupBy.description: Dimension to break the metric down along. Omit it for the overall figure. DATE returns one group per period step and echoes the granularity, NETWORK one per social network, COMPETITOR one per competitor of a competitive search — and no total, since an item matching two competitors counts in both groups.
groupBy.title: Group By

ScheduleConfig.description:
Schedule configuration from the frontend widget.
Fields accept Union[int, str] to support drag-and-drop references like
{{nodeId.values.field}} which get resolved at configuration time.

daysOfWeek.description: Days of week to run on (0=Sunday … 6=Saturday); empty = every day. Supported for seconds/minutes/hours intervals and daily schedules.
daysOfWeek.title: Daysofweek

windowStart.description: Part-of-day start as 24-hour "HH:MM" in the schedule timezone (e.g. "09:00"). Set together with windowEnd; interval frequencies only.
windowStart.title: Windowstart

windowEnd.description: Part-of-day end as 24-hour "HH:MM", inclusive — a run landing exactly on it fires (e.g. "18:00" runs the 6:00 PM tick).
windowEnd.title: Windowend

monthDayStart.description: Part-of-month start day (1-31), inclusive. Set together with monthDayEnd; a start after the end wraps around month end (25→5 = the 25th through the 5th).
monthDayStart.title: Monthdaystart

monthStart.description: Part-of-year start month (1=January … 12=December), inclusive. Set together with monthEnd; a start after the end wraps around the new year (11→2 = November through February).
monthStart.title: Monthstart

ScheduleConfig.title: ScheduleConfig
